About:
Great, ponderous, bookish creature with enthusiasm for cross-referencing and copyediting.  Eats typos for breakfast.  Avoids pronouns when the option presents, writes very well in standard English when necessary.  Passing interest in this Wheel of Time thing, particularly with regard to cultural norms and movements within the series.

Something that isn't Jordan.  Having vague stirrings towards re-reading The Great Hunt, as part of my third or fourth trip through the series.  Any week now.  No need to be hasty.
